capabilities: Display banner images and icons at the top of notes via frontmatter properties
Fetch banner images by keyword from Pexels, Pixabay, Flickr, and Unsplash APIs
Generate banners with AI through the paid Pixel Banner Plus service
Configure per-folder defaults, image shuffling, and per-note positioning and styling
Play confetti and particle effects over open notes
extras: Freemium: core banner features are free; AI generation, banner/video collections, history, and a daily game require a Pixel Banner Plus account with pay-as-you-go tokens, and Ko-fi donors receive free tokens. The README includes a detailed network-use and privacy section listing every external service contacted.
problem: Obsidian notes are plain text files with no built-in way to display a visual banner or icon header at the top of a note.

relations.evidence: Connect to Pexels, Pixabay, Flickr, and Unsplash to automatically fetch banner images based on keywords.
This setting is especially useful for compatibility with other plugins like Make.md

requires.name: Pexels, Unsplash, Pixabay, or Flickr API keys
Pixel Banner Plus tokens for AI generation

summary: Banner plugin that adds customizable header images and icons to notes, sourced from the vault, web URLs, stock photo APIs, or AI generation.
